EFS/S07.title: Summary fails, reload, second Save succeeds: dictation intact, Generate locked then unlocked (both contexts)
EFS/S07.detail: Local QA stack on main 43c38a4f (round-companion-wt-qa, web :6473, Convex :4510); fresh @roundai.test physician per test; every ai/* action the page sent was answered or refused at the browser socket (pre-support.ts aiSocket: anything unscripted is refused), so no model ran; tripwire around every batch: 'no model call'. Spec newspec-c/pre-efs-s07-retry.spec.ts (checkpoints h1–h6 / n1–n6 as the matrix's S07). The chart's first ai/parsing:parsePreRoundNotes call fails at the socket, the second returns today's values. Both modes, 15/15 judged each: after the failure and again after a reload the typed text is in the box word for word and on the server, the message has a failure word ('couldn’t' / 'needs another attempt') and the next step ('tap Save Note'), Generate is disabled; after the successful second Save the values show, no failure message remains, Generate is enabled. Generate was never pressed.
